summary: CERO Therapeutics Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K on August 27, 2026, reporting a secured financing transaction with SRX Global Inc. The company issued a Consolidated Senior Secured Promissory Note consolidating previous unsecured debt totaling $5,666,108.77, with additional advances up to $6,000,000, capped at $11,666,108.77. SRX funded an initial advance of $775,665, less $50,000 for legal expenses. This is a routine debt financing and credit facility arrangement, not a special situation. No strategic corporate event such as an acquisition, tender offer, or restructuring is involved. Watch for future drawdowns and potential default triggers under the note.
